title: Sturdy
text: Sturdy. My daughter is moving into an unfurnished apartment this summer and was in need of furniture. This is a decent, neutral futon that kind of has a mid-century vibe to it. It's a beige color with a hint of sage green to it. It took my daughter and my husband about 30 minutes to put it together. The instructions were okay, but not great. The piece is sturdy and will be good for her apartment. She's excited that it turns into a bed for guests.

product_metadata.title: Futon Sofa Bed, Convertible Sleeper Futon Couch Bed with 2 Cup Holders Armrests for Living Room, Studio, Apartment, Dorm
features: The futon sofa bed has three adjustable angles to easily convert from a sofa to a lounger or sleeper bed.
The middle armrest of the futon with 2 built-in cup holders allows you to enjoy a drink while resting, and can be folded upwards when not in use.
The futon sofa comes with removable memory foam armrests on both sides that can be used as a lumbar pillow for lower back support or a pillow for sleeping.
This futon sofa is well suited for apartment, studio, living room and office.
Dimensions when used as sofa: 73.3" (L) x 36" (W) x 31" (H); Dimensions when used as sleeper bed: 73.3" (L) x 42.5" (W) x 13.8" (H); Weight Capacity: 600 lbs.
